Josh Mandell BTC predictions continue to hit. $400m whale short in profit after liquidation hunt fails. Whale short renames his account ‘Tether FUD’. N. Korea now has $1.4bn of BTC after swaps. OKX suspends DEX services after Bybit hack. SOL futures set to go live on CME today. SOL DEX volumes hit YTD low, BNB flips SOL. TON jumps 20% as Durov returns to UAE. US is going to be the global crypto hub: Bessent. Crypto now a competition for us: Goldman Sachs. S. Korea central bank rules out BTC reserve. ETH shorts continue to hit record levels. Base paid $300k to ETH last month ‘not $11k’. ETH & ZKSync have 80% RWA market share. Aave DAO votes for no new RWA token.

entry.title: Coinshift CEO: Next-Gen Stablecoins Will Underpin 'Trillions of Dollars in Value'
entry.summary: Tarun Gupta spoke to Decrypt about Coinshift's yield-bearing stablecoin csUSDL, and how stablecoins will prove the utility of blockchain-powered trustless financial architecture—ultimately bringing 'every other instrument' on-chain.

entry.title: BTC remains at $83K, CZ denies Binance sale rumour, HYPE bounces back
entry.summary: Bitcoin follows strength in gold despite weak stocks. ’No limit’ to size of strategic BTC reserve. CZ denies rumours of Trump stake in Binance US. HYPE bounces as it adds 20% margin requirement. S & SEI lead alts after large TVL increases. WLFI completes token sale for $550m. Vote to reduce SOL’s inflation fails to pass. Russia using crypto to bypass oil sanctions. 3AC increases claim on FTX, jeopardises re-org. Vermont drops staking case against Coinbase. Stablecoin market cap reaches ATH $235.7bn. US seizes $86m crypto linked to Silk Road ops. Coinbase Ventures to lead Base on Echo platform.

entry.title: Roman Coppola on the Enduring Relationship Between Film and Technology
entry.summary: Roman Coppola discusses transitioning from Hollywood to Web3, emphasizing community-driven filmmaking, using blockchain to empower creators and democratize film production.

entry.title: How DeFi Is Reshaping the Movie Industry
entry.summary: Cutter Hodierne talks about his crypto-thriller "Cold Wallet," highlighting Web3 film distribution, decentralized funding, and the evolving landscape of independent cinema through blockchain technology.

entry.title: Venmo Founder Explains The Plan With JellyJelly
entry.summary: In this episode, we speak to CEO of Jelly Jelly, Iqram Magdon-Ismail, and investor Sam Lessin about why they decided to launch the JELLYJELLY token, how they can separate the product from crypto degeneracy, and if they have a plan for the token yet.

entry.title: BTC dominance Rising, Cool CPI boosts Markets, Coinbase delists memes
entry.summary: Crypto rally post CPI fails to hold. BTC dominance hits 4-year high. ETH/BTC hits 5 year low. ETH drops out of top 20 revenue protocols. Stablecoin market cap surpasses ETH market cap. SEC delays options on Fidelity ETH ETF. Fed classifies BTC as a ‘hard reserve asset’. UAE sovereign fund invests $2bn in Binance. Ripple gets first payments license in Dubai. Ripple-SEC settlement may include sales ban. Russia set to open crypto trading for locals. Rumble buys $17m BTC. Franklin files for SOL ETF with CBOE. Cantor Fitzgerald launches BTC backed lending. Lazarus sends 400 ETH to Tornado cash. MEXC acquires $16m ENA, $20m USDe. India arrests Garantex co-founder.

entry.title: UNDER EXPOSED EP16 - Exploring Bitcoin's Ecosystem Challenges
entry.summary: UNDER EXPOSED brings you coverage of the biggest macro news of the week impacting crypto and broader markets, with a focus on the newest trends, trades and narratives. Join hosts TylerD, Deeze, Geebz and Peter Jennings as they have longer conversations on the hottest sectors in crypto and NFTs, what is moving markets and what they’re buying and selling. Streaming live every Tuesday from 12:00 PM EST to 1:00 PM EST on YouTube and X.
